title: Evidence Artifact Map
description: Maps the current gate/action to exact canonical evidence requirements and emits typed gaps without inferring PASS or granting authority.
intent: Resolve a deterministic, replay-stable evidence map for the current gate/action and verify presence, schema, freshness, task, repository, base, head, and scope bindings.
outcome: Typed gate-evidence-artifact-map with exact requirements, canonical entries, missing/stale/projection gaps, deterministic map_digest, and authority_granted=false.
constraints: The evaluator is pure and offline; materialization, schema, freshness, and identity readbacks are supplied as inputs.
Missing, unavailable, stale, malformed, projected, duplicated, or mismatched evidence fails closed with typed reason codes.
Current gate/action selection is exact and cannot be broadened by the node output.
Equivalent candidate ordering and mapped_at timestamps produce the same map_digest.
The map identifies proof requirements and never grants gate, write, PR, merge, deploy, release, or production authority.
exclusions: Reading or mutating Jira, GitHub, repositories, deployment systems, or production state.
Inferring PASS from a projection, evidence presence, or Jira status.
Creating approvals, broadening scope, changing policy, or authorizing a later gate.
entry_guards: current task, repository, base SHA, and action are available
candidate evidence readbacks are materialized or explicitly unavailable

reason_codes.EVIDENCE_INPUT_INVALID: Input or candidate schema/readback is structurally invalid.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_BINDING_MISMATCH: Task, repository, base, head, scope, gate, action, or artifact binding does not match.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Equivalent evidence keys have contradictory digests.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_PROJECTION_ONLY: A non-canonical projection was supplied for canonical proof.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_MISSING: A required canonical artifact is missing.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_OBSERVABILITY_INCOMPLETE: Evidence presence or freshness cannot be observed.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_CI_BINDING_MISMATCH: Delivery/CI evidence is not bound to the exact head.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_G6_NOT_APPLICABLE: Production evidence is not applicable when G6 is outside scope.
